summary: Baker Hughes filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) reporting it filed a Form CO with the European Commission on May 21, 2026, initiating Phase I review for its pending acquisition of Chart Industries, Inc. The transaction, announced July 28, 2025, involves a merger where Chart will become an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Baker Hughes. Terms such as price per share, premium, and consideration were not restated in this filing. Baker Hughes expects the merger to close in July 2026, subject to EC approval and other conditions. The risk-arb angle centers on Phase I clearance timing and potential remedies.
